chapter.title: OF OFFENCES AGAINST THE PUBLIC TRANQUILLITY

heading: Rioting, armed with deadly weapon.
text: Whoever is guilty of rioting, being armed with a deadly weapon or with anything which, used as a weapon of offence, is likely to cause death, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
